outcome: Intrapartum and neonatal antiretroviral therapy use
cohort: The study included US-born women delivering infants between 2005-2015 in New York City, comparing those with perinatally acquired HIV (PHIV) to those with non-perinatally acquired HIV (NPHIV).
finding: Women with PHIV had lower long-term survival after delivery compared to women with NPHIV, attributed to likely limited HIV treatment options in childhood and longer duration of HIV infection.
mod_finding: Women with PHIV were more likely to deliver by elective C-section (63%) compared to women with NPHIV (49%).
